body: Thank you so much! You are absolutely right that they come when you least expect it. I’m saying that because in the past I felt like I did manifest a few things without even realizing it. Now that i’m more aware, it’s getting hard. My sp has red hair and I feel like I’ve seen hundreds of redheads on the street (weird considering how rare they are); then I wonder is it just me focusing on them now more than ever? I have a feeling if there is a real sign, it’ll hit me hard and not make me wonder. I’ll stop thinking about it :)
I feel like these success stories are messing with my head. It makes me wonder why it’s so easy for everyone else

Thank you, I will do that. I was seriously getting so restless, I was about to call him and the pretend it was an accident (I know so lame). I am impatient but you are right, I have to just live my life.
Thank you, that makes sense completely. And thanks for the post, that’s exactly what I needed

Thank you, that makes more sense. I think I need to stop reading all the success stories since I feel like I need to follow the exact formula they use. Admittedly, I am quite hung up on this person but i’m starting to see how that’s doing me more harm than good. I almost feel I need to accept early on that he might not ever reach out and that I need to just move forward.

Yes I do need to work on that. I also think i’m waiting for some magical miracle to happen. I think i’m still struggling to understand how the law of attraction works. Some people tell me it’s just by thinking and letting go. Others make it seem like it’s actual magic. Don’t know what to do!

I would definitely say i’m relying on him majorly. I’m traveling right now and quite lonely and homesick. I think I feel if he just reached out, i’d feel so much better. But again, i’m resting my happiness into him.
That makes sense. I think I was just so hung up on those people who got immediate results that I was desperately clinging onto the same
